text_blocks.snippet: There is currently no cure for celiac disease. However, a strict, lifelong gluten-free diet can effectively manage the condition, allowing the small intestine to heal and symptoms to subside, according to Penn Medicine. While a cure is not yet available, research is ongoing to develop new therapies that may offer alternative or adjunctive treatments to the gluten-free diet, according to the Celiac Disease Foundation.
